def constantSinglePullbackIso {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : B) :
    (upperStar B f).leftDerivedFunctor.obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
          ((constantSheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology B).obj M)) ≅
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
        ((constantSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology B).obj M)

theorem constantSinglePullbackIso_hom {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : B) :
    (constantSinglePullbackIso B f M).hom =
      (singleFunctorCompLeftDerivedUpperStarIso B f).hom.app
          ((constantSheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology B).obj M) ≫
        (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).map
          ((Scheme.upperStarConstantSheafIso B f).hom.app M)

theorem constantSinglePullbackIso_source_hom {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : B) :
    (constantSinglePullbackIso B f M).hom =
      (leftDerivedUpperStarSingleConstantSheafIso B f M).hom

def shiftedSinglePullbackIso (B : Type v) [Category.{u + 1} B] [Abelian B]
    [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{u + 1} B] [MonoidalCategory B] [MonoidalPreadditive B]
    [SymmetricCategory B] [MonoidalClosed B] [Abelian.HasFunctorialFlatResolution B]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (J : Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology B) (J' : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology B)
    (e : (upperStar B f).obj J ≅ J') (n : ℤ) :
    (upperStar B f).leftDerivedFunctor.obj
        (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj J)⟦n⟧) ≅
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj J')⟦n⟧

def constantSingleSectionUnits {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (s : Y ⟶ X) (p : X ⟶ Y) (M : B) :
    (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
        ((constantSheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology B).obj M) ⟶
      (lowerStar B p).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
        ((lowerStar B s).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
            ((constantSheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology B).obj M)))

The shifted construction also accepts specified degree-zero embeddings and their inverse-image comparison, so a cached presentation can be shifted without reconstructing these functors.

proof.text: Reuse the current genericConstantIso construction for the canonical constant single-object pullback before specializing the coefficient category. Its component formula is definitional; associativity identifies it with the source constant comparison. The shifted comparison is shift commutation followed by the shift of the single-object map and the supplied coefficient isomorphism. These are the original public comparison constructions, cached without arbitrary data or additional hypotheses.

For specified degree-zero functors and their inverse-image comparison, form shift commutation followed by the shift functor applied to that comparison and the coefficient isomorphism. This explicit-factor constructor specializes the same shifted comparison while preserving cached functor data.
